constraints.description: Every bounded universal Tauri plan criterion is mapped to direct, reproducible evidence and no mandatory lane is silently skipped.

validation.validation_method: acceptance matrix, task receipts, focused verifier/tests, strict OpenSpec, and signed 6/6 task state

constraints.description: The shared application retains one normalized graph and ID-only lists: components use hooks; hooks select the canonical graph store and platform orchestration store; only the platform store calls the platform service; platform conditionals remain at the service adapter boundary.

validation.validation_method: universal source verifier, 8 application tests, component/store/service import scans, and implementation receipt

constraints.description: Browser, historical macOS runtime, and current-source macOS build, Android emulator, and iOS simulator evidence remains correctly classified, complete, non-empty, and hash-bound without substituting source inference for runtime proof.

validation.validation_method: task-5 and task-6 platform receipts, 23 retained SHA-256 recomputations, current executable/APK metadata, and original-resolution inspection

constraints.description: Withheld destructive IPC permissions, persisted queue validation, and deep-link scheme/tenant/route/entity policy fail closed before graph mutation.

validation.validation_method: real macOS/Android denial receipts, Rust mock-host tests, unit tests, source rejection tests, and capability manifest inspection

constraints.description: Prometheus branding, desktop/mobile responsive composition, visible native host state, capability denial, and accessibility evidence remain legible and accurately scoped.

validation.validation_method: original-resolution screenshot inspection, five Playwright traces/screenshots, and zero serious/critical axe receipt

constraints.description: Example coverage, package exports, skills, documentation, Changesets, and the release contract agree with the implemented showcase and unchanged public declaration surface.

validation.validation_method: coverage verifier/tests, release-contract tests, aggregate skill verifier, 26/57 Tauri ledger, Changesets status, and evidence hashes

constraints.description: The frozen React 3.0.0-rc.1 source and successful rehearsal remain independent while this continuation's Tauri patch is reserved for a later coordinated prerelease.

validation.validation_method: remote main SHA, npm next absence, release-impact wording, and fixed-group Changesets contract

constraints.description: Windows/Linux, physical-device, assistive-technology, signing, app-store, credential-rotation, aggregate certification, and registry limits remain explicit and no stable/publication authority is implied.

validation.validation_method: verification/release-impact cross-check, postmortem reference, coverage status, registry state, and publication wording scan

global_rules: pnpm is the only JavaScript package manager.
Browser preview cannot certify native desktop or mobile behavior.
Simulator/emulator receipts cannot be relabeled as physical-device or distribution evidence.
The immutable React rc.1 source on remote main must not move while later 3.0 work continues.
Completing this bounded change may authorize only its OpenSpec archive; it cannot authorize npm latest, stable 3.0, GitHub Release, Pages, or app-store publication.
termination_conditions: Terminate only when all eight blocking constraints have current direct evidence.
Require all 23 retained artifact hashes and all focused structural/ledger gates to pass.
Keep aggregate release coverage in-progress and publication unauthorized.
Proceed to archive only after a fresh isolated adversarial review has no critical finding.
